contract_rules.checkpoint_structure: Generic; actual checkpoints come only from an owner-frozen run plan.
contract_rules.raw_signal_evidence: When equipment can export a complete time series, preserve an immutable raw trace. Q2-B checkpoints are preregistered derived metrics, not substitutes for raw evidence; post-hoc point selection is prohibited.
contract_rules.unclassifiable_stop: run_status=INVALID_RUN; deviation required; exclude from Q1/Q2.
contract_rules.no_event_within_10h: Administrative right-censor at 10 h; never business PASS.

legacy_mapping_rule: Preserve the legacy value and source. Map only from event evidence, 10 h censoring evidence, and deviation evidence. Ambiguous cases must be NOT_AUTOMAPPABLE; do not infer from strings.

outcome_rules.no_event_within_10h: event_occurred=false; event_time_h=null; censoring_type=ADMINISTRATIVE_RIGHT_CENSOR; censor_time_h=10; method_outcome=NO_EVENT_WITHIN_10H; business_pass_label=null; stop_reason=ADMINISTRATIVE_10H_END.
outcome_rules.invalid: run_status=INVALID_RUN; deviation required; exclude from Q1/Q2.
